fields: Stock option. Choose forward-only for stop-to-8x with Extended range enabled.
Off keeps stock ranges. On gives +/-4x in vsop 0/1, or stop to forward 8x in vsop 2.
Off: SHIFT + Varispeed locks to the scale. On: pitch is normally quantized; SHIFT + Varispeed temporarily becomes continuous. Release snaps back.
Applies to both quantization modes. Off disables quantization.
For octl 4: comma-separated 1-11, e.g. 3,5,7,10. Root and octaves are always included. 0 means root/octaves only.

With dens 1, startup density comes from dstr (default 8 Genes/sec). Hold SHIFT and turn Gene Size to adjust it from 0.1 to 128 Genes/sec. Knob changes remain until adjusted again, recalled by dstr reload or powered off; they are not saved across power cycles. The configured dstr value is kept in options.txt. Overrides the Turing rate gesture; external clock takes priority.

0.1-128 Genes/sec in 0.1 steps; default 8. Sets the startup rate and recalls the rate on settings-only reload whenever dstr is present, even if unchanged. Use the checkbox below to recall this rate or preserve the current density during settings-only reload. Requires dens 1; external clock takes priority.
Always included in this firmware. On removes the silent gaps at minimum Morph. Higher overlap settings stay unchanged.
Stock option: choose the original or smoother Gene envelope.
Tape mode activates on the first SHIFT + S.O.S. turn after startup. Sets feedback while the ordinary knob still sets the listening mix.
Effect applies to Gene playback. The amount resets on power-up. Warble uses less CPU than sample-rate reduction.
Limits overlap while tape-dubbing. 0 disables the cap; 1-9 means 0.1-0.9. Higher values can increase glitches.
SHIFT + Organize: evolution; SHIFT + Slide: repeating scatter; SHIFT + Gene Size: Genes per step when dens is off.
Chance of choosing the root rather than a chord ratio from mcr1-mcr3. 100 disables pitch changes.
Always copies L to both channels and ignores R. Auto copies L only while R is quiet.
Stock gain index, 0-3. REC held + SHIFT taps changes it on the module; the mod saves it after about 3 seconds.
Writes cpulog.txt periodically. Leave off for normal performance.
features: Enable vrng 1 for +/-4x, or combine it with vsop 2 for stop to forward 8x. Scale locking works across the expanded range.
Choose octaves, fifths, semitones or a custom scale. vqnt 1 keeps pitch quantized normally; SHIFT + Varispeed temporarily frees it. The default vqnt 0 retains SHIFT-to-lock.

With dens 1, startup density comes from dstr, with 8 Genes/sec as the default. Hold SHIFT and turn Gene Size to adjust it from 0.1 to 128 Genes/sec, independently of pitch and Morph. Knob changes remain until adjusted again, recalled by dstr reload or powered off; they are not saved across power cycles. Set dstr to choose a startup and card-recall rate (0.1-128, in 0.1 steps). In the options editor, check “Recall density on settings-only reload” to recall dstr, or uncheck it to preserve the live rate. At 0.1, a new Gene is requested every ten seconds. The knob midpoint remains 8/sec. External clock takes priority; dense, long Genes remain limited by available voices.
Set mlop 1 for seamless looping at the bottom of Morph. Set mlop 0 for the original gaps. Included in mg204+c, disabled by default.
SHIFT + S.O.S. controls tape overdub feedback or classic TLA feedback. SHIFT + Morph adds sample-rate reduction or tape warble. The Morph cap helps keep tape overdubbing within the CPU budget.
SHIFT + Slide scatters Gene start positions. Enable sldm 1 for repeating random steps: SHIFT + Organize controls evolution, and SHIFT + Gene Size sets Genes per step when independent density is off.

Remove the idle card, hold SHIFT alone for one second, then insert a prepared matching card while still holding SHIFT. Settings apply without resetting the reel or playback position; the card remains mounted for recording and saving.
Input gain is remembered. Mono input can copy L onto both channels. Updates can be installed from SD after the first audio install. Includes Briskcat’s splice-overdub fix and flash prefetch.
